sources.entry: GitFinder - Fast and lightweight Git client for Mac with Finder integration.

summary.name: GitFinder
summary.one_liner: A Git client for Mac that integrates with Finder, showing file git status badges and running git operations from Finder menus and a repository browser window.
use_cases: see which files in a repository have changed from Finder
review diffs and blame for files selected in Finder
stage, commit and amend changes on a Mac
resolve conflicted files with a merge tool
manage branches, tags and remote repositories
work with pull requests without opening a browser
summary.what_it_does: GitFinder shows git status of files directly in Finder using icon badges, and lets you run git operations from contextual and toolbar menus. It has a repository browser window for local and remote branches, tags and submodules. Selecting files in Finder opens separate diff and blame windows, and a per-file commit history is available. It supports common operations such as clone, stage, commit, checkout, cherry-pick, revert, merge, rebase, stashes, and creating or deleting remote repos. Keyboard shortcuts are customizable and a shortcut cheat sheet is included.
notable: Finder integration with git status icon badges
Diff and blame windows for files selected in Finder
Pull request handling inside the app
Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts with a cheat sheet
caveats: Page mentions a 30-day no-questions-asked refund policy but does not state pricing or whether it is free, paid or trial
Mac only according to the page
